# Cow Rock Construction

> Ultra-custom home building in the mountains of Cashiers, North Carolina.
> Fifth-generation builder, structural engineering expertise, private mountain estates.

## What we do
- Ultra-custom, bespoke home construction
- Private mountain estate building
- Structural engineering-informed design and construction

## Who leads the work
Richard Jennings, fifth-generation builder. BS in Civil Engineering (NC State
University), MS in Structural Engineering (Georgia Tech). Unlimited North
Carolina General Contractor's License, held since 2014.

## Where we work
Cashiers, North Carolina, and the surrounding mountains of Western North Carolina.
